verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a glancing claim that Render shows critical metrics for all infrastructure and can stream telemetry to external tools. That implies some centralized observability, but it never mentions logs. Agent skills also reference debugging and monitoring, without describing log access. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of build logs, deploy logs, and runtime logs; a unified log view in the dashboard; log search or filtering; independent or hands-on corroboration.
